entries.cold_open: I actually worked with the Fruit Ninja people. My job was kiwi fracture mechanics. Pineapple was substantially harder.
entries.pivot: Apparently we should have been measuring reading scores.
callbacks: This is not my first produce-related clinical surprise.
The eye-tracking version did not work better, which is an expensive way to rediscover the touchscreen.
entries.specificity_anchor: kiwi fracture mechanics and pineapple failure modes

entries.cold_open: At Theranos, my main job was being bled. I am talking liters over the course of a month. By week three, I had opinions about assay validation.
entries.pivot: Which is why tiny-sample diagnostics still make me unusually attentive to what was actually measured.
callbacks: I have already donated enough blood to this business model.
If the assay needs another vial from me, the diligence memo is getting shorter.
entries.truth_boundary: Fictional Satoshi lore only. Any factual discussion of Theranos, its devices, personnel, testing practices, litigation, or regulatory history must use independent evidence.
